verdict.rationale: llamafile is built for self-hosting: one executable bundles the model weights, inference engine and runtime. It runs entirely on your own device, offline, with no external dependencies. It serves a local Web UI and HTTP server, and its server sandbox blocks outbound network connections. Hands-on reports confirm it runs locally on Linux and modest hardware with no network connection. Missing for 10: Windows can't run executables over 4GB, and there are platform-specific failures (NixOS) and friction getting GPU acceleration working.
